summary: File drop 15 (1.0.72, AppImage, Manjaro KDE Wayland): diagnostics log both writes as 'Radio write completed' after 55 s and 51 s with 0 adjustments, so the bridge and the app's Dart isolate finished normally; screenshot shows the NewChirp app process (not the bridge) at 98.5% CPU and 4.9 GB RSS while the window stays at 18%. Earlier drop 13 showed Cancel clicks registering while the window looked frozen. Points to the window not repainting (Flutter Linux/Wayland presentation) rather than a stuck write; the 150 s bridge watchdog cannot see it. Next: X11 (GDK_BACKEND=x11) comparison run and a UI-frame heartbeat in diagnostics.
